messages.content:
You are drafting a reply for a human support agent at a clinical practice-management product. The agent will review and edit it before anything is sent. The ticket was escalated to a human for this reason: safety_rule:billing_dispute: Billing disputes always go to a human. Acknowledge the customer's problem and say a member of the support team is handling it. Do not promise an outcome or a timeline. Give product steps only if a knowledge-base article is provided and it answers the ticket, and take them only from that article. Put the reply in draft.

Reply with only a JSON object and no other text.
Output: review_draft.
The JSON object must match this JSON schema:
{"additionalProperties": false, "description": "A suggested reply for the human agent who takes an escalation.", "properties": {"draft": {"minLength": 1, "title": "Draft", "type": "string"}}, "required": ["draft"], "title": "review_draft", "type": "object"}

Article: none

Ticket:
Billing discrepancy regarding recent subscription invoice

Hello, I am so sorry to bother you with this, but I am reviewing our monthly statement and noticed we were billed twice for the enterprise tier this cycle. We've always valued our partnership with you, but we really need this duplicate charge reversed and credited back to our account as soon as possible. Thank you so much for your help in clearing up this insurance verification clearinghouse and subscription confusion.

value.text:
{
  "draft": "Hello,

Thank you for bringing this to our attention. I understand you’ve noticed a duplicate charge on your recent enterprise tier invoice. I’ve escalated this billing discrepancy to the appropriate team, and a member of our support staff will be reviewing the details.

We appreciate your patience while we look into this matter.

Best regards,
[Your Name]
Support Team"
}
